clue.text: Bishop, one having power — skilled operator backed by more than one faction

the Roman numeral for one

clue.text: Being out to become attractive?

clue.text: Group joined late, seen but not heard? The other way round!

clue.text: All performers given this instruction

explanation.definitionFit: The noun means a person who welcomes visitors and, in Scots dialect, one who weeps or cries.

clue.text: Church dignitary‘s law

blocks.note: first meaning: a member of a cathedral chapter
second meaning: a rule or principle, especially church law

explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe-s reads as possession, a cleric's law; it stands for 'is', joining two meanings.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a cathedral clergyman and also a general rule or body of ecclesiastical decrees.

clue.text: What woman wears in teashop is fancy

indicators.note: fancy means elaborate or fanciful, so the letters are dressed up in a new order

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman's outfit for afternoon tea is rather smart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fancy' looks like an adjective describing the outfit; it is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Pantihose are women's sheer tights covering legs and hips, a garment typically worn by women.

clue.text: Once again spotted problem for Crucible player?

blocks.note: first meaning: found or seen a second time
second meaning read as three words: in snooker, when the red ball is blocked by another ball

explanation.walkthrough: The Crucible is the Sheffield theatre that hosts the World Snooker Championship; a player is snookered when a red is covered by another ball.
explanation.definitionFit: Read as one word it means found again; split as 'red is covered' it is a snooker player's obstructed shot.

clue.text: This is becoming violent, unacceptable from start to finish

indicators.note: one thing becoming another is replaced by it, so a part of the word is swapped out

blocks.note: taken as written; its last two letters are the part swapped
rough means violent
out means not allowed, unacceptable

explanation.surface: Things are turning nasty and remain unacceptable all the way through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is becoming' reads as 'is turning'; it literally means the letters IS in 'This' become another word.
explanation.definitionFit: Throughout means in every part or for the whole duration, from the beginning to the end.
